Name: OhoDavi Style Penny
Author: AnriMachishiro
Description:
If you are a fan of OhoDavi's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1839]stardewvalley anime mods at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community[/url], you must know it has not been adapted for the latest version, so almost every character art doesn't work properly after Nov 2024.
We have good mod creaters in the community, and they've already fixed lots of those characters, but I don't know why Penny is left. So I did it myself last night.

Despite I made all those png files, I am a very new player of Stardew Valley. Actually I haven't completed my first year in the game, so I haven't tested the winter outfit myself. Please feel free to tell me if it doesn't work properly.
